question: Which posture-relevant sensory populations exist with exact identities in the simulated MaleCNS connectome, how directly do they reach leg motor-neuron pools, what is already encoded, and what can the body model measure for each?
feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Read annotation column names and subclass value counts only (hair plate 113, campaniform sensilla 426, chordotonal organ 425, wind_gravity 475, haltere 205, neck 2); entryNerve values; bodymap sensor population names and sizes; the six tibia encoder populations (bodymap chordotonal per leg, 392) and six tactile populations (1877). No identity matching or connectivity was computed.

assignment.side: rootSide if 'L' or 'R', else somaSide if 'L' or 'R', else unknown
assignment.identity: bodyId present in the simulated neuron index (exact integer); unmatched counted

reach.graph: simulated CSR, presynaptic rows, edges with synapse count >= 6 (the engine's min_synapses floor)
reach.targets: bodymap leg motor-neuron entries, grouped by leg (T<seg> <side>) and joint class (actuator prefix)
reach.metrics: for each organ x leg x side x joint class of the SAME leg and side: number of sensory neurons with a direct edge; with at least one two-hop path (both edges >= 6); total direct synapses
reach.non_leg_organs: reported against all leg MN pools pooled per joint class

body_signal_declaration.hair_plate: coxa/trochanter joint angles: measurable (qpos); no encoder for these joints -> AVAILABLE_NO_ENCODER
body_signal_declaration.campaniform_sensilla: cuticular strain/leg load: joint torques and contact forces are in MuJoCo data, but no validated strain-to-load transduction -> AVAILABLE_NO_TRANSDUCTION_MODEL
body_signal_declaration.chordotonal_organ: femur-tibia angle/movement: existing tibia encoder -> AVAILABLE_EXISTING_ENCODER
body_signal_declaration.wind_gravity_JO: gravity via antennal deflection: body orientation measurable, antennal mechanics not modeled -> AVAILABLE_NO_TRANSDUCTION_MODEL
body_signal_declaration.haltere: body angular velocity: root qvel measurable, haltere mechanics absent, mainly a flight sense -> AVAILABLE_NO_TRANSDUCTION_MODEL
body_signal_declaration.neck: head-thorax angle: head joint presence not verified in this inventory -> UNVERIFIED

classification.READY_FOR_ENCODER_DESIGN: matched >= 90%, leg organs: leg+side assigned >= 90%, two-hop reach to same-leg MN pools in >= 50% of the six legs (non-leg: any pool), and signal AVAILABLE_EXISTING_ENCODER or AVAILABLE_NO_ENCODER
classification.PARTIAL: matched >= 90% and any other READY condition fails

interpretation_limits: Data-only inventory: no simulation, encoder, admission or behavioral claim.
Structural reach is not functional influence; annotations are not transduction measurements.
Body-signal declarations are engineering availability statements, not biological validation.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed.
